sec.title: Master Undated Resolution Pipeline (Batch 7 of 1,607)
sec.p: Continuing **Stage 1** of our systematic backlog resolution across all 80,308 undated broadcasts, **Batch 7** resolves an additional **50 broadcasts** from Edward R. Murrow's *This I Believe* on CBS Radio (Sequences 466 through 515).
This cohort highlights cultural giants of American poetry, dramatic theater, Nobel peacemaking, addiction recovery, and public diplomacy.
